name: 玉陵
checkpoints: THREE connected stone burial chambers, with low stone imitation plank-roof profiles and stepped level differences, not timber temples.
Preserve central stone forecourt, raised stone front parapets, squat stone shisa guardians and small dark chamber openings visible in the reference.
Full connected tomb group only, no trees, visitors or invented ornate temple roofs.
